description: Idempotent multi-pass future session merge with flock lock, atomic checkpoint, health probes, and SwarmOrchestrationEngine dispatch
idempotency: flock lock file /tmp/future-session-merge-v3.lock; atomic mv checkpoint; overwrite checkpoint by pass_num
schedule: on-demand or external Automations RRULE when operator creates automation
retry: loop 5 passes; soft-fail if swarm missing logs ERROR and still checkpoints
secrets_policy: KEY NAMES ONLY; redact_secrets ALWAYS; no HF_TOKEN values
